name: C盘防垃圾
description: 防止模型把测试、日志、缓存、临时文件写到系统盘、桌面、下载。垃圾只待在当前项目的 Temp 或 scratch。

en.name: Keep junk off C:
en.description: Keep test, log, cache, and temp files out of the system drive, Desktop, and Downloads. Junk stays in the current project's Temp or scratch.
en.safetyNotes: Behavioral confinement, not a disk lock. The plugin only classifies paths and injects agent rules. It does not change ACLs or use the network.

zh-CN.name: C盘防垃圾
zh-CN.description: 防止模型把测试、日志、缓存、临时文件写到系统盘、桌面、下载。垃圾只待在当前项目的 Temp 或 scratch。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 这是行为约束，不是磁盘锁。插件只分类路径并注入 Agent 规则，不改 ACL、不联网。

author: xingleiwu

agentTools.name: project_root
agentTools.description: Resolve the open PI-Desktop workspace, PI scratch directory, and recommended Temp layout. Fails if no workspace is open and root is omitted.

root.description: Optional project root override; use only for a root explicitly selected by the user. The tool cannot verify that selection.

agentTools.name: check_path
agentTools.description: Classify whether a write path is allowed. Read allowed, not ok. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace, not the plugin process cwd. allowed=false must be redirected into the workspace or PI scratch.

root.description: Optional project root override; use only for a root explicitly selected by the user. The tool cannot verify that selection.

explicit.description: Set true only when the user clearly named this destination

agentTools.name: temp_env
agentTools.description: Return TMP/TEMP/cache environment assignments that keep tool junk inside the project Temp and PI scratch.

root.description: Optional project root override; use only for a root explicitly selected by the user. The tool cannot verify that selection.

shell.description: Script dialect for the env assignments. Defaults to PowerShell on Windows and bash elsewhere.

agentTools.name: tmp_layout
agentTools.description: Return the recommended $project/Temp/{tests,scripts,cache,out} layout without creating files.

root.description: Optional project root override; use only for a root explicitly selected by the user. The tool cannot verify that selection.

changelog: 0.2.7：市场名称改为「C盘防垃圾」；项目垃圾改放到 $project/Temp/；拒绝把 Temp 倾倒目录当项目根。 0.2.6：市场名称改为直白中文。 0.2.5: Quote generated bash and PowerShell assignments safely, reject unsafe cmd values, enforce canonical root/scratch and symlink boundaries, include negative-path tests in CI, and sync the package. 0.2.4：说明改为中文。0.2.3：去掉 git/cwd 作为项目根回退；cmd 环境变量拒绝内嵌引号；覆盖工作区 API 失败与 explicit 临时目录拒绝。0.2.2：相对路径相对工作区解析。0.2.1：explicit 目标与 XDG_DOWNLOAD_DIR。0.2.0：跨机器便携。
safetyNotes: 这是行为约束，不是磁盘锁。插件只分类路径并注入 Agent 规则，不改 ACL、不联网。
